systemic.title: Mass problems concentrated on Brackenridge Steel loads, with declared weights consistently light
systemic.evidence: Engine pattern: Brackenridge Steel Supply declares light on 217 of 217 loads; weighbridge payload averages 7.5% above declared over 4 weeks. Today MV1102-1236 is measured 45.2 t against a 44.0 t limit, with declared weight 14% under weighbridge. MV1102-1237 has its weighbridge ticket pending and MV1102-1238 has no weighbridge ticket or JSEA.
systemic.recommendation: Require Brackenridge Steel to correct its declared weights and supply weighbridge-verified figures before dispatch. Loaders should weigh and hold loads without a ticket until the declaration is corrected and the combination limit is confirmed.

systemic.title: Speeding at Princes Hwy, Corio is tied to the Greyfield Building delivery slot, not to individual drivers
systemic.evidence: Engine pattern: 5 drivers (D09, D14, D16, D26, D30) with 20 events at Princes Hwy, Corio (80 to 60), all 5-9 km/h over, all on trips to Greyfield Building, 12-17 minutes before the booked slot. Each driver has only one minor SPD-WATCH event today.
systemic.recommendation: Review the Greyfield Building delivery slot with the consignor so arrival does not require running ahead of the 60 km/h zone, and have the scheduler build the dispatch around that window before coaching individual drivers.

systemic.title: Planned rosters breach fatigue rules for several drivers
systemic.evidence: Today's findings: FAT-24H-REST for D24, D33, D34; FAT-24H-WORK for D24 and D33 (12 h work in 24 h); FAT-7D-REST and FAT-7D-WORK for D18; FAT-HEADROOM for D01 with only 35 min left on the 24 h work limit. Several of these are planned shifts, so the breach is in the roster itself.
systemic.recommendation: Rebuild the planned shifts for D24, D33, D34 and D18 to clear the 7 h major rest and the 12 h and 72 h work limits, and add a pre-publication fatigue check to roster build so planned breaches are blocked before drivers are rostered.

systemic.title: Trailer TR15 has an open major brake defect and PM12 is due on a rolling schedule
systemic.evidence: MNT-OPEN-DEFECT shows 9 entries on TR15 for an open major air leak at the trailer brake chamber (axle 2, nearside). MNT-SERVICE-SOON shows 9 PM12 service-due entries (Wed 04 Nov, at 20,750 down to 20,110 km). PM21 passes its service point on 3 trips.
